# On-Page

1 endpoint, all GET. Base URL `https://www.socialcrawl.dev`, auth header `x-api-key: $SOCIALCRAWL_API_KEY`.

**Credit costs:** 1 standard (1 credit) - the exact cost is in each endpoint heading below.

A single-URL on-page SEO audit: the technical, content, and meta checks for one page in one 1-credit call. For crawling a whole site, use the `web` platform's async crawl instead.

<!-- BEGIN:GENERATED:ENDPOINTS (auto-generated by generate-docs.ts - AIP-16b) -->

## GET /v1/on_page/page - 1 credit (standard)

Run an on-page SEO audit for one URL

**Cost** 1 credit (standard) · **Cache** 1800s (a hit costs 0 credits) · **Returns** Analytics · **Pagination** none

Returns a technical on-page audit for one URL: title, meta, heading counts, on-page score, checks (HTTPS, canonical, broken links), and page timing. One credit per call.

**Query params**

- `url` (required) - Absolute page URL to audit, including https://. · e.g. `https://www.socialcrawl.dev/`
- `enable_javascript` (optional, boolean) - Set true to execute JavaScript while loading the page. Default false.

```bash
curl "https://www.socialcrawl.dev/v1/on_page/page?url=https://www.socialcrawl.dev/" \
  -H "x-api-key: $SOCIALCRAWL_API_KEY"
```
